summary.text: Andrew Perchlik is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Washington District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He has served in the Senate since January 2019 and chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Perchlik took office in the Vermont State Senate on January 9, 2019, succeeding Francis Brooks.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee, chair of the Economic Development, Housing and General Affairs Committee and membership on the Senate Transportation Committee.
